{"adopted_chinese":"一份细致的研究笔记摘要，里面充满了分解和重组各种物质的公式。\n它由污泥精灵中一位传奇炼金术士所写，在那个种族神秘地从世界上消失之前。\n作者似乎对变成蝴蝶有一种奇怪的痴迷，\n但即使他们的最终目标没能实现，书中详述的许多咒语仍然相当实用。","adopted_english":"A meticulous compendium of research notes, filled with formulae for decomposing\nand reconstituting all manner of substances. {"adopted_chinese":"这个盒子里满是堕落巫师的奇异实验残留。打开它会释放一只友好的变异兽：\n每只奇异的生物都有自己的一套特质。激活技能越强，释放出的野兽就越强。\n\n有六种已知的特质：\n ＊蝙蝠野兽能飞行且十分迅捷，但行动失序。\n ＊火焰野兽能抵抗并喷吐火焰。\n ＊公牛野兽耐寒，皮毛厚实，能击退敌人。\n ＊电击野兽能抵抗电流并能变形成活体闪电。\n ＊刺叮野兽能抵抗毒素，并以可隔格攻击的毒尾刺击敌人。\n ＊诡秘野兽能看见隐形并用触手进行束缚攻击。\n\n众所周知，任何野兽都恰好具有二种特质。","adopted_english":"A box filled with the bizarre leftovers of a depraved wizard's magical\nexperimentations. Opening it might set loose a friendly mutant beast: bizarre\ncreatures, each with their own combination of traits. Increased skill with\nEvocations will allow stronger beasts to be released.\n\nThere are six known traits:\n * Bat beasts fly and move very quickly, but erratically.\n * Fire beasts resist and breathe fire.\n * Ox beasts resist cold, are armoured with thick fur, and can knock back foes.\n * Shock beasts resist electricity and can transform into living lightning.\n * Sting beasts resist poison and have a reaching poison-tail attack.\n * Weird beasts can see invisible and attack with constricting tentacles.\n\nAs far as anyone knows, all beasts have exactly two of these traits.","consumer":"item_def::name(DESC_DBNAME) -> getLongDescription","current_chinese":"这个盒子里满是堕落巫师的奇异实验残留。打开它会释放一只友好的变异兽：\n每只奇异的生物都有自己的一套特质。激活技能越强，释放出的野兽就越强。\n\n有六种已知的特质：\n ＊蝙蝠野兽能飞行且十分迅捷，但行动失序。\n ＊火焰野兽能抵抗并喷吐火焰。\n ＊公牛野兽耐寒，皮毛厚实，能击退敌人。\n ＊电击野兽能抵抗电流并能变形成活体闪电。\n ＊刺叮野兽能抵抗毒素，并以可隔格攻击的毒尾刺击敌人。\n ＊诡秘野兽能看见隐形并用触手进行束缚攻击。\n\n众所周知，任何野兽都恰好具有二种特质。","english_source":"A box filled with the bizarre leftovers of a depraved wizard's magical\nexperimentations. {"adopted_chinese":"这个魔法装置，可以将周围的能量凝结成各种具有破坏性的云。\n当激活时，生成的云会环绕使用者附近的敌人。\n这些云的数量和杀伤力会随激活技能的提高而提高。\n当能量低时，它会生成毒烟，当能量增加时，会生成咆哮的火焰、冰汽和毒气。\n当能量达到最高级别时，会生成强大的风暴云、酸雾和郁积愁云。","adopted_english":"A magical device that condenses ambient energy into various destructive clouds.\nWhen evoked these clouds form around hostile monsters near the user. {"adopted_chinese":"一个装有令人不安发光物质的小玻璃球。捏碎它将使你充满变形能量，\n使你的物理形态在基本层面上变得不稳定。\n\n在这种变形状态下，你的近战攻击弱得多，但每次攻击会用变形能量污染\n被击中的目标——第三次攻击时变得如此强烈，以至于会导致它们的身体\n扭曲变形，造成显著伤害。物理形态的不确定性也使你更难被击中，\n尽管你发光的方式会妨碍潜行。\n\n每个小球中蕴含的力量是有限的，一旦通过传播给敌人而耗尽，\n你将恢复之前的形态。","adopted_english":"A small glass bauble containing an ominously glowing substance. Crushing it will\nflood you with transmutational energy, leaving your physical form unstable at a\nfundamental level.\n\nIn this state of flux, your melee attacks are much weaker, but each strike will\ncontaminate whatever you hit with transmutational energy - growing so intense\nupon the third strike that it will cause their body to twist and deform,\ninflicting significant damage. The lack of certainty in your physical form also\nmakes you much harder to hit, though you glow in a way that hinders stealth.\n\nThe power contained in each bauble is finite, and once it is exhausted by\nspreading it to enemies, you will return to your previous form.","consumer":"item_def::name(DESC_DBNAME) -> getLongDescription","current_chinese":"一个装有令人不安发光物质的小玻璃球。捏碎它将使你充满变形能量，\n使你的物理形态在基本层面上变得不稳定。\n\n在这种变形状态下，你的近战攻击弱得多，但每次攻击会用变形能量污染\n被击中的目标——第三次攻击时变得如此强烈，以至于会导致它们的身体\n扭曲变形，造成显著伤害。物理形态的不确定性也使你更难被击中，\n尽管你发光的方式会妨碍潜行。\n\n每个小球中蕴含的力量是有限的，一旦通过传播给敌人而耗尽，\n你将恢复之前的形态。","english_source":"A small glass bauble containing an ominously glowing substance. Crushing it will\nflood you with transmutational energy, leaving your physical form unstable at a\nfundamental level.\n\nIn this state of flux, your melee attacks are much weaker, but each strike will\ncontaminate whatever you hit with transmutational energy - growing so intense\nupon the third strike that it will cause their body to twist and deform,\ninflicting significant damage. The lack of certainty in your physical form also\nmakes you much harder to hit, though you glow in a way that hinders stealth.\n\nThe power contained in each bauble is finite, and once it is exhausted by\nspreading it to enemies, you will return to your previous form.","identity":"item-description:flux bauble","input":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt","lifecycle":"current","metadata":{"category":"item-description","description_key":"flux bauble"},"pre_review_chinese":"一个装有令人不安发光物质的小玻璃球。捏碎它将使你充满变形能量，\n使你的物理形态在基本层面上变得不稳定。\n\n在这种变形状态下，你的近战攻击弱得多，但每次攻击会用变形能量污染\n被击中的目标——第三次攻击时变得如此强烈，以至于会导致它们的身体\n扭曲变形，造成显著伤害。物理形态的不确定性也使你更难被击中，\n尽管你发光的方式会妨碍潜行。\n\n每个小球中蕴含的力量是有限的，一旦通过传播给敌人而耗尽，\n你将恢复之前的形态。","producer":"DescriptionDB key flux bauble","reentry_trigger":"Re-review if the English source, adopted Chinese, lifecycle, producer/consumer, glossary, grammar metrics, or source SHA changes.","semantic_reason":"keep: item-description:flux bauble at DescriptionDB key flux bauble -> item_def::name(DESC_DBNAME) -> getLongDescription has no adopted semantic field differing from the review base; the adopted rendering preserves the accepted meaning, terminology, grammar identity, and gameplay-facing consumer.","source_files":[{"current_sha256":"0219fddf2c8f488b3041d452dd2911f80b0cc95ddfb47136574b5df53e4733ab","path":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt","review_base_sha256":"0219fddf2c8f488b3041d452dd2911f80b0cc95ddfb47136574b5df53e4733ab"},{"current_sha256":"7fc06d83c3656f0fcc00c03e61e606dd2bd8698504af213d69a80209d6a5be76","path":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt","review_base_sha256":"46ceb24e5280dcd036644e704cb924ee8b23e3a0233356a7b6ea8d9809d0366b"}],"terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"adopted_chinese":"一个从贝壳碎片雕刻而成的微型城垛。将佩戴者变成一只重甲螃蟹，\n在此过程中将其穿戴的身体护甲融入壳中。在此形态下，它们移动缓慢，\n但防御良好，甚至能用其大螯持有武器。尽管如此笨重，\n它们非常适应水中环境。它们还可以消耗自身生命值喷吐锈蚀云雾，\n腐蚀并削弱敌人。","adopted_english":"A miniature battlement, carved from a piece of shell. Transforms the wearer into\na heavily armoured crab, fusing whatever body armour they are wearing into the\nshell in the process. In this form, they are slow-moving, but well-defended and\neven capable of wielding a weapon in their large main claw. Despite all this\nbulk, they are well-adapted to the water. They can also breathe clouds of rust\nat the cost of their own HP, which corrode and weaken enemies.","consumer":"item_def::name(DESC_DBNAME) -> getLongDescription","current_chinese":"一个从贝壳碎片雕刻而成的微型城垛。将佩戴者变成一只重甲螃蟹，\n在此过程中将其穿戴的身体护甲融入壳中。在此形态下，它们移动缓慢，\n但防御良好，甚至能用其大螯持有武器。尽管如此笨重，\n它们非常适应水中环境。它们还可以消耗自身生命值喷吐锈蚀云雾，\n腐蚀并削弱敌人。","english_source":"A miniature battlement, carved from a piece of shell. Transforms the wearer into\na heavily armoured crab, fusing whatever body armour they are wearing into the\nshell in the process. In this form, they are slow-moving, but well-defended and\neven capable of wielding a weapon in their large main claw. Despite all this\nbulk, they are well-adapted to the water. They can also breathe clouds of rust\nat the cost of their own HP, which corrode and weaken enemies.","identity":"item-description:fortress talisman","input":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt","lifecycle":"current","metadata":{"category":"item-description","description_key":"fortress talisman"},"pre_review_chinese":"一个从贝壳碎片雕刻而成的微型城垛。将佩戴者变成一只重甲螃蟹，\n在此过程中将其穿戴的身体护甲融入壳中。在此形态下，它们移动缓慢，\n但防御良好，甚至能用其大螯持有武器。尽管如此笨重，\n它们非常适应水中环境。它们还可以消耗自身生命值喷吐锈蚀云雾，\n腐蚀并削弱敌人。","producer":"DescriptionDB key fortress talisman","reentry_trigger":"Re-review if the English source, adopted Chinese, lifecycle, producer/consumer, glossary, grammar metrics, or source SHA changes.","semantic_reason":"keep: item-description:fortress talisman at DescriptionDB key fortress talisman -> item_def::name(DESC_DBNAME) -> getLongDescription has no adopted semantic field differing from the review base; the adopted rendering preserves the accepted meaning, terminology, grammar identity, and gameplay-facing consumer.","source_files":[{"current_sha256":"0219fddf2c8f488b3041d452dd2911f80b0cc95ddfb47136574b5df53e4733ab","path":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt","review_base_sha256":"0219fddf2c8f488b3041d452dd2911f80b0cc95ddfb47136574b5df53e4733ab"},{"current_sha256":"7fc06d83c3656f0fcc00c03e61e606dd2bd8698504af213d69a80209d6a5be76","path":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt","review_base_sha256":"46ceb24e5280dcd036644e704cb924ee8b23e3a0233356a7b6ea8d9809d0366b"}],"terminal_conclusion":"keep"}
{"adopted_chinese":"一面铜和钨制成的铃鼓，在你的手中兴奋地振动着，仿佛渴望被使用。\n\n正如音乐将人们聚到一起，以正确的节奏摇动它将把一大群怪物吸引到\n一个狭窄的空间中，并用无法逃脱的碾压重力波将所有敌对目标\n固定在原地一小段时间。\n\n效果范围和持续时间随激活技能提升。","adopted_english":"A copper and tungsten tambourine that vibrates excitedly in your hands, as if\neager to be used.\n\nJust as music brings people together, shaking it with the proper rhythm will\ndraw a large group of monsters into a narrow space and hold any hostile ones in\nplace for a short time with inescapable waves of crushing gravity.\n\nThe area of effect and duration increases with Evocations skill.","consumer":"item_def::name(DESC_DBNAME) -> getLongDescription","current_chinese":"一面铜和钨制成的铃鼓，在你的手中兴奋地振动着，仿佛渴望被使用。\n\n正如音乐将人们聚到一起，以正确的节奏摇动它将把一大群怪物吸引到\n一个狭窄的空间中，并用无法逃脱的碾压重力波将所有敌对目标\n固定在原地一小段时间。\n\n效果范围和持续时间随激活技能提升。","english_source":"A copper and tungsten tambourine that vibrates excitedly in your hands, as if\neager to be used.\n\nJust as music brings people together, shaking it with the proper rhythm will\ndraw a large group of monsters into a narrow space and hold any hostile ones in\nplace for a short time with inescapable waves of crushing gravity.\n\nThe area of effect and duration increases with Evocations skill.","identity":"item-description:gell's gravitambourine","input":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt","lifecycle":"current","metadata":{"category":"item-description","description_key":"gell's gravitambourine"},"pre_review_chinese":"一面铜和钨制成的铃鼓，在你的手中兴奋地振动着，仿佛渴望被使用。\n\n正如音乐将人们聚到一起，以正确的节奏摇动它将把一大群怪物吸引到\n一个狭窄的空间中，并用无法逃脱的碾压重力波将所有敌对目标\n固定在原地一小段时间。\n\n效果范围和持续时间随激活技能提升。","producer":"DescriptionDB key gell's gravitambourine","reentry_trigger":"Re-review if the English source, adopted Chinese, lifecycle, producer/consumer, glossary, grammar metrics, or source SHA changes.","semantic_reason":"keep: item-description:gell's gravitambourine at DescriptionDB key gell's gravitambourine -> item_def::name(DESC_DBNAME) -> getLongDescription has no adopted semantic field differing from the review base; {"adopted_chinese":"一块来自地牢之外美丽绝伦、价值难以估量的石头。在它的范围内，它是完全无用的。\n\n佐特小心翼翼地贮藏着这些宝石，\n一旦冒险者进入存在宝石的地牢分支，佐特就会恶意地打碎相应宝石。\n然而，一个行动极其迅速的冒险者有机会抓到一个宝石，并保留其珍贵的碎片。\n佐特无法在存放宝石的原分支之外继续追踪它，\n因此，如果有真正惊人的速度，是有可能带着一颗完好无损的宝石成功逃脱……\n然而这样的壮举简直是天方夜谭，而且可能毫无意义。\n\n一旦佐特宝珠被拿走，佐特将无法打碎任何宝石。","adopted_english":"A stone of unearthly beauty and almost immeasurable value outside the dungeon.\nWithin its confines, it is utterly useless.\n\nZot hoards these gems jealously, and will spitefully smash them soon after an\nadventurer enters the branch of the Dungeon in which they rest. Still, a very\nquick-moving adventurer might seize one first and keep its precious shards.\nZot cannot track gems outside their home branches, so with truly astonishing\nspeed, it might be possible to abscond with one still intact... but such a\nfeat is difficult to credit, and likely pointless besides.\n\nOnce the Orb of Zot is taken, Zot will be unable to smash any gems.","consumer":"item_def::name(DESC_DBNAME) -> getLongDescription","current_chinese":"一块来自地牢之外美丽绝伦、价值难以估量的石头。在它的范围内，它是完全无用的。\n\n佐特小心翼翼地贮藏着这些宝石，\n一旦冒险者进入存在宝石的地牢分支，佐特就会恶意地打碎相应宝石。\n然而，一个行动极其迅速的冒险者有机会抓到一个宝石，并保留其珍贵的碎片。\n佐特无法在存放宝石的原分支之外继续追踪它，\n因此，如果有真正惊人的速度，是有可能带着一颗完好无损的宝石成功逃脱……\n然而这样的壮举简直是天方夜谭，而且可能毫无意义。\n\n一旦佐特宝珠被拿走，佐特将无法打碎任何宝石。","english_source":"A stone of unearthly beauty and almost immeasurable value outside the dungeon.\nWithin its confines, it is utterly useless.\n\nZot hoards these gems jealously, and will spitefully smash them soon after an\nadventurer enters the branch of the Dungeon in which they rest. Still, a very\nquick-moving adventurer might seize one first and keep its precious shards.\nZot cannot track gems outside their home branches, so with truly astonishing\nspeed, it might be possible to abscond with one still intact... but such a\nfeat is difficult to credit, and likely pointless besides.\n\nOnce the Orb of Zot is taken, Zot will be unable to smash any gems.","identity":"item-description:gem","input":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt","lifecycle":"current","metadata":{"category":"item-description","description_key":"gem"},"pre_review_chinese":"一块来自地牢之外美丽绝伦、价值难以估量的石头。在它的范围内，它是完全无用的。\n\n佐特小心翼翼地贮藏着这些宝石，\n一旦冒险者进入存在宝石的地牢分支，佐特就会恶意地打碎相应宝石。\n然而，一个行动极其迅速的冒险者有机会抓到一个宝石，并保留其珍贵的碎片。\n佐特无法在存放宝石的原分支之外继续追踪它，\n因此，如果有真正惊人的速度，是有可能带着一颗完好无损的宝石成功逃脱……\n然而这样的壮举简直是天方夜谭，而且可能毫无意义。\n\n一旦佐特宝珠被拿走，佐特将无法打碎任何宝石。","producer":"DescriptionDB key gem","reentry_trigger":"Re-review if the English source, adopted Chinese, lifecycle, producer/consumer, glossary, grammar metrics, or source SHA changes.","semantic_reason":"keep: item-description:gem at DescriptionDB key gem -> item_def::name(DESC_DBNAME) -> getLongDescription has no adopted semantic field differing from the review base; the adopted rendering preserves the accepted meaning, terminology, grammar identity, and gameplay-facing consumer.","source_files":[{"current_sha256":"0219fddf2c8f488b3041d452dd2911f80b0cc95ddfb47136574b5df53e4733ab","path":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt","review_base_sha256":"0219fddf2c8f488b3041d452dd2911f80b0cc95ddfb47136574b5df53e4733ab"},{"current_sha256":"7fc06d83c3656f0fcc00c03e61e606dd2bd8698504af213d69a80209d6a5be76","path":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt","review_base_sha256":"46ceb24e5280dcd036644e704cb924ee8b23e3a0233356a7b6ea8d9809d0366b"}],"terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"adopted_chinese":"一个沉重的石符，上面有一个被遗忘已久的国王或是神明的头像。\n它能将使用者变成一个缓慢的石像。\n使用者的石质身躯免疫毒和瘴气，并获得对电、负能量和折磨的抗性。\n提升变形术技能可以增加该形态赋予的护甲。","adopted_english":"A heavy stone icon, bearing the countenance of some long-forgotten king or god.\nTransforms the wearer into a slow, stone statue. {"adopted_chinese":"一块由狼皮碎片制成的涂色眼罩。将佩戴者变成一只凶猛的狼人，\n肌肉涌动着掠食本能。在此形态下用近战攻击击杀敌人将为你提供\n叠加的伤害和命中加成，连续击杀足够多的敌人将导致你释放出\n凶猛的嚎叫，使任何还活着的敌人因恐惧而畏缩——\n并使它们容易被毁灭性的跳跃扑杀攻击。","adopted_english":"A painted eyepatch made from a scrap of wolf pelt. {"adopted_chinese":"某种凶猛而且但愿已经灭绝的生物的干缩头颅。\n它能将使用者的腹部变成一个咬牙切齿、准备吞食敌人的大嘴。\n这张大嘴能赋予强大的咬击，其伤害还会随使用者的力量进一步提升，\n并且可以吞食被杀死的生物来暂时提升使用者的再生速度。\n不幸的是，它也会带来极度的饥饿感，让人难以摆脱特别诱人的敌人。","adopted_english":"A miniature, desiccated head of some ferocious and hopefully extinct creature.\nTransforms the wearer's midsection into a giant mouth, gnashing and ready to devour\nfoes. {"adopted_chinese":"这瓶药水能让饮用者陷入一种失去理智的狂暴状态，\n极大地但暂时地提升其生命值、伤害力和速度。\n作为代价，他们的心智会被愤怒所蒙蔽，只能进行移动和近战攻击。\n如果不攻击怪物，狂暴状态会迅速消退；状态结束后，饮用者将陷入疲惫，\n行动大幅减缓，并在短时间内无法再次狂暴。","adopted_english":"A potion which can send one into an incoherent rage, granting them a great but\ntemporary increase to their health, damage, and speed. {"adopted_chinese":"一块不断变化的原始物质碎片；其物质似乎在血肉、骨骼甚至金属之间波动。\n足够熟练的变形者可以将其稳定成可用的——尽管不可预测的——形态。\n\n（如果你的变形术技能至少为6，尝试戴上它将使其随机变成以下之一：\n霜角、圣甲虫、美杜莎或孢子护符。）","adopted_english":"An ever-changing fragment of something primordial; its substance seems to\nundulate between flesh and bone and perhaps even metal. {"adopted_chinese":"一个内含未知奖品的精巧谜盒。将佩戴者变成一只爱好谜语的斯芬克斯。\n在此形态下，他们{{\n    if you.race() == \"Felid\" then\n        return \"通常能够穿戴披风和马铠（尽管你自身的微小体型会阻止这一点）\"\n    else\n        return \"能够穿戴披风和马铠\"\n    end\n}}，其近战攻击会引起强风打击敌人，相邻每多一格空地，伤害就越高。\n他们还是高超的惑控师，更容易施放诅咒系法术，\n并忽略敌人一部分的意志力。\n\n唉，他们对谜语的热爱如此强烈，以至于即使是最坚毅的冒险者也无法\n抗拒向遇到的新敌人提出谜语，无论这可能多么不明智。","adopted_english":"An intricate puzzlebox containing an unknowable prize. {"adopted_chinese":"一件由稀有极地野兽的角雕刻而成的粗糙饰品——触感如此寒冷，冰仍然附着\n在上面。将佩戴者变成一头霜角牦牛，一种高度抵抗寒冷的坚韧有蹄动物，\n其呼吸如此冰冷，以至于在战斗中会冻结周围的墙壁。对极地温度的如此适应\n也使佩戴者更容易施放寒冰魔法。","adopted_english":"A crude ornament carved from the horn of a rare arctic beast - so cold to the\ntouch that ice still clings to it. {"adopted_chinese":"一瓶翻涌的鲜血，随着一颗无形心脏的搏动而脉动。将佩戴者变成一个\n可怕的吸血鬼——一种跨越生命与亡灵界限的生物。它们可以吸取活物的\n生命之血来治愈自己，甚至可以将那些潜行击杀的生物变成吸血仆从，\n但在有怪物时不会自然恢复。在巨大努力下，它们可以散开成一群蝙蝠——\n要么逃跑，要么攻击敌人。","adopted_english":"A vial of roiling blood that pulses with the beat of an unseen heart. Transforms\nthe wearer into a fearsome vampire - a creature that straddles the border between\nlife and undeath. They can drink the lifeblood of the living to heal themselves,\nand even turn those they slay stealthily into vampiric thralls, but do not heal\nin the presence of monsters. {"adopted_chinese":"一个甲虫形状的小金浮雕。将佩戴者变成一只太阳圣甲虫，\n一种携带着灼热与光明的火虫，在其身外像一颗微型太阳。\n\n当圣甲虫攻击时，这颗太阳余烬会灼烧相邻的敌人，\n与其交换位置可以治愈圣甲虫。此外，圣甲虫自身的下颚可以降低\n敌人的火焰抗性，佩戴者也更容易施放火焰法术。","adopted_english":"A small golden cameo of a beetle. {"adopted_chinese":"这张卷轴能给武器加上一个随机的铭印。\n任何已有的铭印会被一个不同的替代，且不会加上你当前的神所抵触的铭印。\n神器无法以这种方式获得铭印。\n\n近战武器通常会获得火焰、冰冻、重击、淬毒或防护铭印，\n（或该类武器专属的特殊铭印），但很少会被印上汲取、电击、幽魂、吸血或混沌铭印。\n\n远程武器通常会获得火焰、冰冻、重击或汲取铭印，\n但很少会获得电击或混沌铭印。","adopted_english":"A scroll that imbues a weapon with a random brand. Any existing brand will be\nreplaced with a different one, and any brand forbidden by your current god will\nnot be chosen. {"adopted_chinese":"这张卷轴可以消除读者周围的所有声音。\n这使读者附近无法阅读卷轴、施放法术、调用神圣能力或喊叫。\n\n某些怪物具有与生俱来的魔法或特殊能力，即使被沉默也能使用。\n\n起始的生效范围较大，然后会缩小，最后只覆盖施法者，直到完全失效。","adopted_english":"A scroll that eliminates all sound near the reader. {"adopted_chinese":"一件由蜕下的蛛形纲外骨骼用蜘蛛丝捆扎成的奇异护符。将佩戴者变成\n一只敏捷的跳蛛，能迅速向敌人移动，并对任何被其发现的毫无防备者\n造成重创。它不会被网困住，但其攻击可以将敌人困入网中。\n它也可以迅速跳离许多危险。","adopted_english":"A strange charm made from shed arachnid exoskeletons bound together with silk.\nTransforms the wearer into an agile jumping spider who can move swiftly towards\nfoes and inflict grievous damage on any it catches unaware. {"adopted_chinese":"一件由仍活着的蘑菇制成的小护符。将佩戴者的一只手臂和部分下半身变成\n一团充满活力的彩色真菌。在此形态下的近战攻击可能释放出削弱目标的孢子，\n并导致蘑菇在它们身后的地面上生长，如果允许其生长，会释放出自身的\n致眩孢子爆发。变形术技能提高这些蘑菇的耐久度和伤害。","adopted_english":"A small charm made from a still-living mushroom. {"adopted_chinese":"闪电不可思议地被捕获在一个瓶子里。\n它能让使用者在空中穿行，如同一股狂暴的、充满闪电的风暴。\n使用者的近战攻击将带有电属性，会打击到所有相邻的敌人。\n使用者还能够飞行，免疫毒、瘴气、石化、束缚和粘性火焰，并有了电抗。\n他们可以像闪电箭一样发射自己，炸开挡路的一切。","adopted_english":"Lightning trapped, impossibly, in a bottle. {"adopted_chinese":"一个灰黑色的容器，以令人不安的仪式向其注入了黑暗的力量。\n它能将使用者变成对生命本身永不消亡的亵渎之物。\n\n被使用者用近战武器或手击中的敌人会被虚弱、减速、衰竭。\n使用者还可以通过折磨附近的活物敌人来治疗自己；提升变形术技能能增加治愈量。\n此外，使用者将能抵抗寒冷，意志力会增强，并免疫毒、瘴气、负能量和折磨。\n\n使用者还能从这副亡灵身躯中获得一些颇为可疑的好处。\n然而，他们易受神圣攻击和驱散亡灵的伤害，且无法服用药水。","adopted_english":"A grey-black vessel, infused with dark power through a sickening ritual.\nTransforms the wearer into an undying offence against life itself.\n\nFoes struck by wearer's melee weapons or hands are weakened, slowed, and drained.\nThe wearer can also heal themself by tormenting living foes nearby; Shapeshifting\nskill increases the amount healed. Further, the wearer resists cold, has enhanced\nwillpower, and is immune to poison, miasma, negative energy, and torment.\n\nThe wearer also gains some of the more dubious benefits of having an undead body.\nThey are vulnerable to holy damage and Dispel Undead, and cannot consume potions.","consumer":"item_def::name(DESC_DBNAME) -> getLongDescription","current_chinese":"一个灰黑色的容器，以令人不安的仪式向其注入了黑暗的力量。\n它能将使用者变成对生命本身永不消亡的亵渎之物。\n\n被使用者用近战武器或手击中的敌人会被虚弱、减速、衰竭。\n使用者还可以通过折磨附近的活物敌人来治疗自己；提升变形术技能能增加治愈量。\n此外，使用者将能抵抗寒冷，意志力会增强，并免疫毒、瘴气、负能量和折磨。\n\n使用者还能从这副亡灵身躯中获得一些颇为可疑的好处。\n然而，他们易受神圣攻击和驱散亡灵的伤害，且无法服用药水。","english_source":"A grey-black vessel, infused with dark power through a sickening ritual.\nTransforms the wearer into an undying offence against life itself.\n\nFoes struck by wearer's melee weapons or hands are weakened, slowed, and drained.\nThe wearer can also heal themself by tormenting living foes nearby; Shapeshifting\nskill increases the amount healed. Further, the wearer resists cold, has enhanced\nwillpower, and is immune to poison, miasma, negative energy, and torment.\n\nThe wearer also gains some of the more dubious benefits of having an undead body.\nThey are vulnerable to holy damage and Dispel Undead, and cannot consume potions.","identity":"item-description:talisman of death","input":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt","lifecycle":"current","metadata":{"category":"item-description","description_key":"talisman of death"},"pre_review_chinese":"一个灰黑色的容器，以令人不安的仪式向其注入了黑暗的力量。\n它能将使用者变成对生命本身永不消亡的亵渎之物。\n\n被使用者用近战武器或手击中的敌人会被虚弱、减速、衰竭。\n使用者还可以通过折磨附近的活物敌人来治疗自己；提升变形术技能能增加治愈量。\n此外，使用者将能抵抗寒冷，意志力会增强，并免疫毒、瘴气、负能量和折磨。\n\n使用者还能从这副亡灵身躯中获得一些颇为可疑的好处。\n然而，他们易受神圣攻击和驱散亡灵的伤害，且无法服用药水。","producer":"DescriptionDB key talisman of death","reentry_trigger":"Re-review if the English source, adopted Chinese, lifecycle, producer/consumer, glossary, grammar metrics, or source SHA changes.","semantic_reason":"keep: item-description:talisman of death at DescriptionDB key talisman of death -> item_def::name(DESC_DBNAME) -> getLongDescription has no adopted semantic field differing from the review base; the adopted rendering preserves the accepted meaning, terminology, grammar identity, and gameplay-facing consumer.","source_files":[{"current_sha256":"0219fddf2c8f488b3041d452dd2911f80b0cc95ddfb47136574b5df53e4733ab","path":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/items.txt","review_base_sha256":"0219fddf2c8f488b3041d452dd2911f80b0cc95ddfb47136574b5df53e4733ab"},{"current_sha256":"7fc06d83c3656f0fcc00c03e61e606dd2bd8698504af213d69a80209d6a5be76","path":"crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/items.txt","review_base_sha256":"46ceb24e5280dcd036644e704cb924ee8b23e3a0233356a7b6ea8d9809d0366b"}],"terminal_conclusion":"keep"}

{"adopted_chinese":"一组休眠的、有磁性的土元素，外形是微小的、非常重的鹅卵石。\n当释放时，元素会被磁力吸引到附近怪物的中心，\n在那里，它们会因在休眠时被扰动而愤怒地爆炸。\n震颤石通常会稍微偏离目标，并且使用者总有被击中的风险。\n然而，护甲在抵挡震颤石的爆炸中所迸发的轻质岩石碎片非常有效，\n所以一个护甲精良的使用者没什么好担心的。提升激活技能能增加爆炸次数。","adopted_english":"A set of dormant, magnetic earth elementals in the form of tiny, very heavy\npebbles. {"adopted_chinese":"一个似乎能涌出无尽之水的小型双耳瓶。将佩戴者的肉体变成元素之水，\n使其能够灵活移动并从很远的距离攻击。\n偶尔，它们甚至可以让周围的水升起并淹死敌人。\n\n这种水的可塑性甚至允许它们保留物理变异的好处，但寒冷攻击可以将水\n冻结成固体，火焰可能导致其爆发出蒸汽。","adopted_english":"A small amphora from which pours a seemingly unending quantity of water.\nTransforms the wearer's flesh into elemental water, allowing them to move flexibly\nand reach to attack from a great distance.
